title: Cloverfield Crossing
description: Start in broad meadow, climb clover slopes, cross a stream and squeeze through the hedge before the fields open again.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

signs.text:
The low meadow
Stay low over the first roots

The clover slopes
Follow the clover up the bank

The shallow stream
Use the broad bridge stones

Within the hedgerow
The route narrows between the hedges

The open field beyond
The horizon opens again
